Name: Pink Tools Recolor (content patcher)
Author: seaf0ampudding
Description:
Welcome to Kayla's Pink Tool Recolors! Has this been done before? Probably. Did I still want to make some of my own? Yea.

List of tools recolored (all upgrades):
-Hoe
-Pickaxe
-Axe
-Watering can
-Scythe (Including golden scythe)
-Fishing rod (including training rod)
-Trash cans
-Shears and milk pail
-Magnifying glass
-Return scepter

Issues with the mod? Contact me at 00spongeboblover00224@gmail.com.
Hope you enjoy!
